description: Data underlying the publication: Inferring vehicle spacing in urban traffic from trajectory data provides processed outputs used to infer urban vehicle spacing from pNEUMA trajectory data. The provider is Research creators via 4TU.ResearchData. Geographical and temporal coverage: The 2025 deposit supports a single named publication and inherits the source experiment's coverage. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: These are derived study outputs, not a new independent traffic-observation campaign. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
